**Findings**

1. **[P1] Failed Responses streams can become clean completions.**  
   [contracts.ts:214](/Users/cooper/.codex/worktrees/d4b4e069-1303-427d-957e-756d18e049a9/bundjil/packages/codex/src/provider/contracts.ts:214), [http-client.ts:123](/Users/cooper/.codex/worktrees/d4b4e069-1303-427d-957e-756d18e049a9/bundjil/packages/codex/src/provider/http-client.ts:123), [stream-mapper.ts:241](/Users/cooper/.codex/worktrees/d4b4e069-1303-427d-957e-756d18e049a9/bundjil/packages/codex/src/provider/stream-mapper.ts:241)  
   Reproduced: `response.failed -> response.completed -> output_text.delta` produced proof success, emitted the post-terminal text, then emitted `finish_reason: stop` and `[DONE]`. The generic event Schema validates only an arbitrary non-empty `type`, while both consumers track only whether completion appeared somewhere.  
   **Earliest owner:** a Schema-owned terminal-event union and state machine in `provider/contracts.ts`, consumed with `Match`.  
   **Oracle:** proof and live tests must reject failed-then-completed, completed-then-delta, duplicate terminal events, and malformed completion payloads, with no `[DONE]`.

2. **[P1] Provider-controlled Content-Type escapes into safe errors and proof output.**  
   [error-contracts.ts:4](/Users/cooper/.codex/worktrees/d4b4e069-1303-427d-957e-756d18e049a9/bundjil/packages/codex/src/provider/error-contracts.ts:4), [codex-http-status-error.ts:11](/Users/cooper/.codex/worktrees/d4b4e069-1303-427d-957e-756d18e049a9/bundjil/packages/codex/src/provider/errors/codex-http-status-error.ts:11), [http-client.ts:85](/Users/cooper/.codex/worktrees/d4b4e069-1303-427d-957e-756d18e049a9/bundjil/packages/codex/src/provider/http-client.ts:85), [http-client.ts:154](/Users/cooper/.codex/worktrees/d4b4e069-1303-427d-957e-756d18e049a9/bundjil/packages/codex/src/provider/http-client.ts:154)  
   Reproduced: `text/event-stream; audit-secret=leaked` was copied verbatim into a successful proof receipt. Non-2xx responses likewise retain raw Content-Type, and the public error contract permits arbitrary `statusText`.  
   **Earliest owner:** normalize transport observations into closed values in `error-contracts.ts`; emit fixed `text/event-stream` after validation and remove raw provider text from public errors.  
   **Oracle:** secret-sentinel headers on both 2xx and 401 responses must not appear in encoded results, errors, logs, or host responses.

3. **[P1] The 1 MiB event ceiling does not measure actual wire bytes.**  
   [sse.ts:147](/Users/cooper/.codex/worktrees/d4b4e069-1303-427d-957e-756d18e049a9/bundjil/packages/codex/src/provider/sse.ts:147), [sse.ts:215](/Users/cooper/.codex/worktrees/d4b4e069-1303-427d-957e-756d18e049a9/bundjil/packages/codex/src/provider/sse.ts:215)  
   The event accumulator re-encodes each line and adds one byte, even when the wire delimiter was two-byte CRLF; it also omits the terminating blank line. Reproduced: an ignored-field event of **1,048,582 wire bytes** passed the 1,048,576-byte ceiling and the proof subsequently succeeded.  
   **Earliest owner:** preserve exact consumed wire-byte counts in the line framing contract.  
   **Oracle:** fixtures immediately below/above the ceiling for LF, CRLF, and CR, including ignored-only events.

4. **[P1] Sub-limit SSE input permits quadratic allocation.**  
   [sse.ts:140](/Users/cooper/.codex/worktrees/d4b4e069-1303-427d-957e-756d18e049a9/bundjil/packages/codex/src/provider/sse.ts:140), [sse.ts:169](/Users/cooper/.codex/worktrees/d4b4e069-1303-427d-957e-756d18e049a9/bundjil/packages/codex/src/provider/sse.ts:169), [sse.ts:243](/Users/cooper/.codex/worktrees/d4b4e069-1303-427d-957e-756d18e049a9/bundjil/packages/codex/src/provider/sse.ts:243)  
   Array spreading copies all preceding fragments for every chunk and every `data:` field. Roughly 174,000 minimal `data:` lines fit under 1 MiB but trigger billions of element copies; a line delivered in tiny chunks has the same problem.  
   **Earliest owner:** the SSE accumulator representation and explicit fragment/field ceilings.  
   **Oracle:** deterministic limit-plus-one tests for line fragments and event fields, avoiding timing-based assertions.

5. **[P2] CRLF framing breaks when an empty transport chunk separates CR and LF.**  
   [sse.ts:109](/Users/cooper/.codex/worktrees/d4b4e069-1303-427d-957e-756d18e049a9/bundjil/packages/codex/src/provider/sse.ts:109)  
   `skipLeadingLineFeed` is cleared by an empty chunk. A valid multi-line event split as `...\r`, empty chunk, `\n...` was decoded as two separate payloads.  
   **Earliest owner:** line-framer state transition.  
   **Oracle:** direct parser fixtures containing zero-length chunks at every CRLF boundary.

6. **[P2] Numeric boundary Schemas admit impossible values.**  
   [error-contracts.ts:4](/Users/cooper/.codex/worktrees/d4b4e069-1303-427d-957e-756d18e049a9/bundjil/packages/codex/src/provider/error-contracts.ts:4), [contracts.ts:54](/Users/cooper/.codex/worktrees/d4b4e069-1303-427d-957e-756d18e049a9/bundjil/packages/codex/src/provider/contracts.ts:54), [contracts.ts:214](/Users/cooper/.codex/worktrees/d4b4e069-1303-427d-957e-756d18e049a9/bundjil/packages/codex/src/provider/contracts.ts:214), [contracts.ts:466](/Users/cooper/.codex/worktrees/d4b4e069-1303-427d-957e-756d18e049a9/bundjil/packages/codex/src/provider/contracts.ts:466)  
   Reproduced Schema acceptance of status `200.5`, negative fractional byte/event counts, and `output_index: -1.5`.  
   **Earliest owner:** named HTTP-status, non-negative-count, and output-index Schemas.  
   **Oracle:** direct Schema rejection tests for fractional, negative, and out-of-range values.

7. **[P2] The raw-export recurrence oracle covers only the root subpath.**  
   [public-exports.test.ts:22](/Users/cooper/.codex/worktrees/d4b4e069-1303-427d-957e-756d18e049a9/bundjil/packages/codex/test/public-exports.test.ts:22), [package.json:14](/Users/cooper/.codex/worktrees/d4b4e069-1303-427d-957e-756d18e049a9/bundjil/packages/codex/package.json:14)  
   Current `/runtime` source is clean, but re-exporting a raw mapper or HTTP service there would not fail the denylist test even though `/runtime` is supported.  
   **Earliest owner:** supported-export contract test.  
   **Oracle:** inspect root, `/runtime`, `/testing`, `/local`, and `/filesystem-store` namespaces with path-specific allow/deny lists.

Repository-only checks currently pass: Codex `129/129`, Photon `44/44`, both package typechecks, `check:boundaries`, and `git diff --check`. Those green checks do not invalidate the reproduced false positives above. No files, providers, credentials, deployments, commits, or documentation were changed, and no live Codex or Photon claim was tested.
